questions.question: If X and Y are the two digits of the number 347XY such that the number is completely divisible by 80, then what is the minimum value of X + Y?
questions.solution:
For any number to be completely divisible by 80, it must be divisible by 8 and 10 both

So, for the number 347XY to be divisible by 10 the last digit must be a 0

This means, Y = 0 and also for any number to be divisible by 8 the last three digits of the number must be divisible by 8.

When 347X0/(10 × 8)

Thus gives 347X divides exactly by 8

So, the last three digits ie 47X must be divisible by 8

This means X = 2

∴ X + Y = 2 + 0 = 2

**Note∶** This question has been asked in the actual paper of SSC CGL Tier I held on 5 Aug 2017 shift 1. The solution has been provided accordingly.

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a work in 20, 24 and 30 days respectively. All three of them starts together but after 4 days A leaves the job and B left the job 6 days before the work was completed. C completed the remaining work alone. In how many days was the total work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time is taken by A to complete a work = 20 days 

Time is taken by B to complete a work = 24 days 

Time is taken by C to complete a work = 30 days 

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Total time taken

**Calculation:**

 The LCM for 20, 24, 30 is (120)

Total work = 120 units

The efficiency of A = 120/20 ⇒ 6 units/day

The efficiency of B = 120/24 ⇒ 5 units/day

The efficiency of C = 120/30 ⇒ 4 units/day

The efficiency of A + B + C = 6 + 5 + 4 ⇒ 15 units/day

The efficiency of B + C = 5 + 4 ⇒ 9 units/day

A, B, C work together for first 4 days = 15 × 4 = 60 units

Remaining work = 120 - 60 ⇒ 60 units

B left the work 6 days before completion

so,C completed the remaining work in last 6 days = 4 × 6 = 24 unit

Middle work = Total work - First work - last work

The B and C complete the work in middle days = 120 - 60 - 24 = 36 units

Time taken by B and C to do the middle days work = 36/9 ⇒ 4 days

Total Time taken to complete the work = 4 + 4 + 6 ⇒ 14 days

**∴ In 14 days the total work completed was completed**

questions.question: A solid sphere of diameter 17.5 cm is cut into two equal halves. What will be the increase (in cm²) in the total surface area?
questions.solution:
Radius of the sphere is 17.5/2 = 8.75

When the sphere is cut into two halves, the curved surface area will stay the same and two additional surfaces will be created which are circular with radius equal to the area of the sphere.

Hence the increase in area will be the increase due to these circular surfaces

Area of each circular surface will be given by = π × (radius)² = π × 8.75 × 8.75 = 240.625

∴ Total increase in area = 2 × 240.625 = 481.25 cm²

questions.question: After a discount of 34% an article is sold for Rs 3168. What is the marked price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
Discount = 34% of marketed price

Let marketed price be = M

Discount = 0.34 × M

Selling price = M - Discount = M - 0.34 × M = 0.66 × M

⇒ 0.66 × M = 3168

∴ M = Rs 4800

questions.question: The average of 17 results is 60. If the average of first 9 results is 57 and that of the last 9 results is 65, then what will be the value of 9th result?
questions.solution:
Average of all 17 results is = 60

Sum of all 17 results = 60 × 17 = 1020

Average of first 9 results = 57

Sum of first 9 results = 57 × 9 = 513

Average of last 9 results = 65

Sum of last 9 results = 65 × 9 = 585

Both sums I.e. of first 9 and last 9 digits include the 9 result

So if we add both sums it will have the 9th result one extra time and we can subtract the actual sum from this addition to get the 9th result

So sum of first and last 9 results = 513 + 585 = 1098

∴ The 9th result will be = 1098 - 1020 = 78

questions.question: For an article the profit is 170% of the cost price. If the cost price increases by 20% but the selling price remains same, then what is the new profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let cost pric be X

Profit will be = 1.7 × X

Selling price will be = X + 1.7 × X = 2.7 × X

If the cost price is increased by 20%, the new cost price will become = 1.2 × X

New profit will be = Selling price - New Cost price = 1.5 × X

∴ Profit percentage = (1.5 × X ) × 100/1.2 × X = 125%

questions.question: A person lent certain sum of money at 5% per annum simple interest and in 15 years the interest amounted to Rs. 250 less than the sum lent. What was the sum lent (in Rs)?
questions.solution:
Let the sum lent be P

Simple interest after 15 years at 5% = P × 0.05 × 15 = 0.75 × P

This amount is less than P by Rs 250

Hence P - 0.75 × P = 0.25 × P = 250

∴ P = 1000

questions.question: If X = frac{{2 + sqrt 3 }}{{2 - sqrt 3 }} then what is the value of X + (1)/(X)
questions.solution:
begin{array}{l} X = frac{{2 + sqrt 3 }}{{2 - sqrt 3 }}\ Rightarrow (1)/(X) = frac{{2 - sqrt 3 }}{{2 + sqrt 3 }}\ Rightarrow X + (1)/(X) = frac{{2 + sqrt 3 }}{{2 - sqrt 3 }} + frac{{2 - sqrt 3 }}{{2 + sqrt 3 }} end{array}

⇒ X + 1/X = (2+√3 )² + (2- √3)²

⇒ X + 1/X = 4 + 3 + 4 × √3 + 4 + 3 - 4 × √3

∴ X + 1/X = 14

questions.question: If x = 2 + √3, then what is the value of [√(2x) + 1/√(2x)]
If x + (1)/(x) = 4, then what is the value of {x⁵} + (1)/({{x⁵)}} ?
questions.solution:
x + 1/x = 4 ----(1)

Squaring eq (1) both sides, we have

x² + 1/x² + 2 = 16

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 14 ----(2)

Now, again squaring eq (2) on both sides, we have

(x² + 1/x²)² = 14²

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 196

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 194 ----(3)

Now, again cubing both sides, we have

(x + 1/x)³ = 4³

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3(1 + 1/x) = 64

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × 4 = 64

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 64 - 12

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 52 ----(4)

Multiplying eq (1) and eq (3), we have

(x + 1/x)(x⁴ + 1/x⁴) = 4 × 194 = 776

⇒ x⁵ + 1/x³ + x³ + 1/x⁵ = 776

⇒ x⁵ + 1/x⁵ + 52 = 776

⇒ x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = 776 - 52

⇒ x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = 72

In the triangle ABC, ∠BAC = 50° and the bisectors of ∠ABC and ∠ACB meets at P. What is the value (in degrees) of ∠BPC?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb7dcd2911d3084e0bf969c4a0abe45fd72d52ffe1d168824586c72122742caa.png] 

There will be two triangles formed here namely ABC and BPC. For triangle ABC, the sum of angles is 180° and one angles is 50°

The sum of remaining two angles will be = 180° - 50 = 130°

Now the sum of all angles of triangle PBC is 180°

Two of these angles are halves of angles ABC and ACB so their sum will be half of angles ABC and ACB = 130/2 = 65°

∴ The third angle is BPC which is = 180 - 65 = 115°

questions.question: Two circles of same radius intersect each other at P and Q. If the length of the common chord is 30 cm and distance between the centres of the two circles is 40 cm, then what is the radius (in cm) of the circles?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b94190d7ed7436c2dfe3fda35bb1e5a6261b096d7efc74b882c5f5de9f8d1420.png] 

The radius is the perpendicular bisector of the common chord.

The distance is 40 cm and if we join P and Q it will cut the common chord in half and the point of intersection assumed M.

A and B are centres of the two circles

APM and AQM will be two right triangles.

AP = AQ = radius

Using Pythagoras theorem AP² = PM² + AM² = 400 + 15² = 400 + 225 = 625

∴ AP = 25

questions.question: What is the simple annual growth rate (in %) of the number of students of Business from 2012 to 2016?
questions.solution:
Total increase from 2012 to 2016 for business students = 48 - 32 = 16

Total percentage increase = 16 × 100/32 = 50%

∴ Annual increase = 50/4 = 12.5%

**Common Mistake∶**

The increase/decrease has been made in 4 years, not in 5 years.

Hence, the annual increase will be 50/4 = 12.5% not 50/5 = 10%
